title: Inspect intent and code independently from one Item
preconditions: Use implementation-deck browser fixture with surprise Item referencing src/app.go; add an explains relation from that Item to Understand a request.

steps.action: Open the Item details and choose its Story control.
steps.expected_result: Both Story and Code controls exist; Linked stories drawer shows the one linked story and authored rationale.

steps.action: Close Linked stories, reopen Item details and choose Code.
steps.expected_result: Linked code drawer opens for the Item.

steps.action: Inspect each drawer while opening it in turn.
steps.expected_result: Story drawer contains only corresponding intent and Code drawer only corresponding code, without unrelated drawer content.

expected_result: Story drawer contains only corresponding intent and Code drawer only corresponding code, without unrelated drawer content.
